catalogRulesText:
Hi! Thank you for using my service! I really appreciate all of the support!
All of art style in this catalog section have deadline 4 days. Ordering = Agreed. 

== Rules ==
1. Unlimited Revision/Change. As long it is still either sketch or lineart. Any change request past that, I will charge you additional fee.
2. Please keep in mind that with more change requested, that could extend the deadline. This rule also applied to 1 Day and 2 Day Request.
3. All the prices must be detailed using my pricing feature on catalog
4. All design request for either vtuber/adopt/game, I will charge you additional fee. Because it will be used for commercial. 
5. Respect me and I will respect you.
6. All details and reference must be discussed before placing the order.
7

== Payment ==
1. Payment will be done by "Down Payment". I will ask for first half after we both agreed with the sketch.
2. For the remaining payment, I show you the finished work progress. Then I will ask you to send the remaining payment before I send you the final file.
